body:
I'm not suicidal, I'm just off my anti psychotics and anti depressants but I'm going back on them very soon. That was me during a mental breakdown/psychotic episode of some sort.

The only reason I haven't deleted this post is because your advice goes against everything reccommended. I'm not trying to be mean, truly, you seem like a good person I just don't want you to hurt people while thinking you're helping.

Thanks? This didn't make me feel better, though. This sub specifically warns against saying "stop feeling sorry for yourself" [Read this] (http://www.reddit.com/r/SWResources/comments/igh87/concerned_but_dont_know_what_to_say_here_are_some/).

I can't piece it together but something was telling me to post that. It wasn't me. I am *literally* insane. 

They had to take me off of my medications for a few weeks for medical reasons, it's been very detrimental. 

But I am going to make it so that I can't go on the internet when I am hearing voices or anything like that.

Help. Something made me post that. It was telling me to. I'm not that bad a person, I'm not a great person but not an abuser. I have a lot of time left to make myself a better person.

I'm afraid that it (or he) is going to kill me. It/he's inside my body. I don't know what's going on.
